mapper.select:
select v.*,dict_label as visceraName, concat('C',dict_value) as visceraCode from tb_viscera_tag v left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_code = v.viscera_id
AND d.dict_label like CONCAT('%',#{params.visceraName},'%')
AND v.matched = #{params.matched}
and date_format(v.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.accessTime.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(v.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.accessTime.endTime},'%y%m%d')
